$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-devicedata-degenerate.xml, transcribed element by element from the XML bytes - NOT produced by e142DocumentToJson (Rule 10, D-030). Task 13's negative case, and the first value is the STANDARD'S OWN: E142-0225 R1-2.1 writes an array of three doubles as <F8>145.4 933.0 1727.1</F8>, which is not schema-valid because ccs:F8 is xsd:double, a single atomic value - and the very next value of the same figure uses <Arr> correctly, so the standard contradicts itself inside one example. Here it is a JSON string, which is the faithful analogue: in XML every value is text and this one fails to convert, and in JSON three doubles cannot be written as one number either. Both paths report E138_PV_LEXICAL, drop the value to null and parse on, because a consumer will meet this document in the field and must not reject it. The remaining values cover NoValue with no reasonCode, NoValue with a reason outside NoValueReasonEnumType (carried verbatim rather than normalised, so a reader sees what the producer wrote), and one value more than there are Parameters, which breaks the positional binding Table 19 makes a shall. THIS FIXTURE IS SCHEMA-INVALID ON PURPOSE - see SCHEMA_INVALID in tests/lib/representations.mjs.
